basic_details.major_restrictions: Open to all qualifying English-taught Master's programs in Engineering, Technology, Natural Sciences, Computer Science, Robotics, Biomedical Engineering, Business & Public Administration, and Applied Sciences.
basic_details.number_of_awards_total: ~50 scholarships awarded annually across all university faculties
basic_details.number_of_awards_pakistan: Competitive merit pool open to non-EU students (typically 3 to 7 Pakistani scholars annually)
basic_details.duration_of_scholarship: Up to 2 academic years (subject to meeting Year 1 credit threshold of 50% or 55 ECTS credits)

eligibility_requirements.academic_qualifications: Completed 4-year Bachelor's degree (16 years education) with exceptional standing, belonging to the top 5–10% of their graduating class.
eligibility_requirements.grading_conversion_notes: Equivalent to an average grade of at least 7.5 to 8.0 on the Dutch 10-point scale or CGPA 3.50+ / 4.00.
eligibility_requirements.subject_background_prerequisites: Undergraduate degree directly aligned with chosen MSc specialization with substantial engineering and mathematics credits.
eligibility_requirements.current_education_status: Graduated or currently in final semester of undergraduate studies.
eligibility_requirements.work_experience_notes: Not mandatory; technical internships and lab research projects evaluated positively.

english_proficiency.notes: IELTS 6.5 (min 6.0 in all subscores) or TOEFL iBT 90 (min 20 in all subscores) strictly required; MOI letters not accepted.

eligibility_requirements.previous_scholarship_restrictions: Must not have already completed a master's degree at UT.

tuition_fee.details: Scholarship value between €3,000 and €22,000 per year (typically €6,000 to €12,000/yr), directly credited against tuition fees (€13,000 to €17,000/yr). Can be augmented by Kipaji Scholarship.

admission_application_fee.details: Application fee (€100) on Osiris portal paid by applicant.

accommodation.details: On-campus or Enschede student housing arranged through Roomspot; rent paid by student (~€350–550/mo).

monthly_stipend.details: Stipend or living allowance is bundled into the overall scholarship allocation (up to €22,000/yr total funding package).

visa_fee.details: Dutch IND residence permit fee (€210) processed by university and paid by student.

health_insurance.details: Aon Student Insurance (~€50–60/month) arranged for international students.

food_allowance.details: Self-funded via grocery and campus canteens (~€250/mo).

books_and_materials_allowance.details: All course software, supercomputing clusters, and digital libraries provided.

research_funding_conference_grant.details: Paid master's thesis research internships available at UT research institutes (MESA+, TechMed, Digital Society Institute).

university_and_program_options.single_or_multiple_universities: Single institution: University of Twente (Enschede, Netherlands).
university_and_program_options.university_rankings_scope: Top 200 QS World University Rankings; Top 100 globally in Engineering and Technology.
available_majors: Computer Science (Data Science, Software Tech, Cybersecurity), Robotics and Mechatronics, Interaction Technology, Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Biomedical Engineering, Nanotechnology, Applied Mathematics, Business Information Technology, Sustainable Energy Technology
university_and_program_options.admission_requirements_summary: 4-year Bachelor's degree in engineering/computer science with strong math preparation.
university_and_program_options.easiest_hardest_institutions_guidance: Must receive conditional admission to an eligible UT Master's program before applying on the UTS portal.
university_and_program_options.strategic_program_match_advice: Apply for university admission by December/January so that you have the student number needed to submit the UTS scholarship application in Round 1 (February 1 deadline).

application_process_roadmap.portal_system_name: University of Twente Osiris Scholarship Application System
application_process_roadmap.account_creation_instructions: Step 1: Apply for MSc program on Studielink.nl and Osiris. Step 2: Use UT student number to log in and apply on the UTS scholarship portal.
step_by_step_workflow: 1. Submit Master's application via Studielink and Osiris (November-December).
2. Receive (conditional) admission letter with student number.
4. Complete motivation questions and upload CV.
5. Submit before Round 1 (February 1) or Round 2 (May 1) deadline.
application_process_roadmap.university_vs_scholarship_routing: Sequential: University admission required first, followed by separate scholarship portal application.
application_process_roadmap.personal_statement_prompts: Explain what makes you an exceptional candidate, your academic ambition, and how your UT studies will impact your field.
application_process_roadmap.cv_format_requirements: Academic curriculum vitae emphasizing technical skill sets and projects.
application_process_roadmap.attestation_requirements: Original digital transcripts verified by home university registrar; certified copies submitted upon arrival.
application_process_roadmap.translation_requirements: English certified translations required for all non-English documents.
application_process_roadmap.final_submission_method: 100% online through University of Twente Osiris portal.

required_documents_checklist.specification: Official admission letter from University of Twente containing student ID
Complete transcripts for 16-year education with grading scale
CV detailing technical projects, software proficiencies, and coursework
required_documents_checklist.pakistan_specific_instruction: Include GitHub links and final year design project

required_documents_checklist.specification: Structured motivation letter answering portal prompts
required_documents_checklist.pakistan_specific_instruction: Focus on academic excellence and research potential

important_dates_timeline.annual_cycle_notes: Round 1 closes February 1; Round 2 closes May 1. Round 1 offers the greatest allocation of high-tier scholarships.

selection_process_and_weights.selection_panel_composition: Faculty scholarship assessment committee of University of Twente.
selection_process_and_weights.evaluation_methodology: Screening of academic excellence (GPA / class percentile) -> Evaluation of motivation statement -> Final faculty ranking.

competitiveness_profile.typical_academic_and_research_profile: Graduates from NUST, FAST, GIKI, UET Lahore with top class rankings, outstanding math/engineering foundations, and high academic ambitions.
competitiveness_profile.common_backgrounds_of_winners: Strong alumni presence in Twente's Robotics, Embedded Systems, and Nanotechnology programs.
competitiveness_profile.high_representation_countries: India, China, Indonesia, Iran, Turkey, Nigeria, Vietnam, Pakistan.

red_flags_and_warnings.application_fee_warning: University application fee (€100) is paid only inside Osiris portal. UTS application itself has no additional fee.
red_flags_and_warnings.agent_and_intermediary_warnings: No third-party consultancy has any influence on the UTS selection committee.
itemized_hidden_out_of_pocket_costs: Tuition balance if receiving partial tier (€4,000 to €8,000/year out of pocket)
Living proof of funds required by Dutch IND (€1,000/mo or €12,000/year)
Airfare Pakistan to Amsterdam Schiphol (~PKR 180,000 to 250,000)
debunked_myths_and_misconceptions: MYTH: UTS covers 100% of all expenses. (Truth: UTS provides up to €22,000/year; students may need to supplement living costs or tuition balance).
MYTH: You need to know Dutch. (Truth: University of Twente is 100% English-friendly across all master's programs and campus operations).
official_vs_unofficial_discrepancies: Agents advertise UTS as a universal full ride; in practice, awards range from €3,000 to €22,000 based on faculty merit tiers.

scholarship_obligations_and_terms.minimum_gpa_maintenance: Must earn at least 50% of European credits (30 ECTS credits) by end of Year 1 to qualify for Year 2 scholarship renewal.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.attendance_requirements: Regular participation in scheduled coursework and lab exercises.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.work_restrictions_during_study: Permitted to work up to 16 hours per week during term time (requires work permit TWV applied by employer) or full-time during June, July, and August.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.home_country_return_obligation: None; graduates can apply for the Dutch Zoekjaar (Orientation Year) visa allowing 1 year of unrestricted work in the Netherlands.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.repayment_clawback_conditions: Scholarship is cancelled if student discontinues studies or fails credit progression threshold.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.rules_for_changing_major: Transferring to a different MSc program requires re-evaluation and is generally not permitted.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.extension_policy: Maximum duration is 2 academic years; no extension beyond 24 months.

official_sources_verified.source_name: University of Twente - Scholarship Finder (UTS Official Portal)
data_points_missing_or_unpublished_by_so: Exact tier breakdown (€3,000 vs €6,000 vs €12,000 vs €22,000) allocation percentages by program.
Internal scoring weighting between transcript GPA and motivation letter in Round 1 vs Round 2.
